Zur Stellenübersicht Bewerben Lehrstelle Kaufmann / Kauffrau EFZ Spital Affoltern AG - Affoltern am Albis Lehrstelle Dauer 3 Jahre August 2027 Dein Aufgabengebiet Als Kauffrau/-mann EFZ in Ausbildung rotierst Du im Spital Affoltern im Halbjahresmodus durch alle für Deinen künftigen Beruf relevanten Abteilungen: Am Empfang begrüsst Du unsere Kunden persönlich und nimmst releante Patientendaten auf. In der Beschaffung nimmst Du Einblick in eine professionelle Lagerbewirtschaftung und kümmerst Dich um interne Bestellungen aller Art. Die Personalabteilung begrüsst Deine Unterstützung in der Erstellung von Arbeitsverträgen und der Organisation von Anlässen sehr. Im dritten Lehrjahr durchläufst Du alle Prozesse im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen und lernst im Marketing das Handwerk einer professionellen internen und externen Kommunikation. Daneben besuchst Du während 2 Tagen pro Woche die Wirtschaftsschule KV Zürich. Dein Profil
• obligatorische Schulzeit abgeschlossen (Sek. A)
• Deutsch: gut bis sehr gut (schriftlich und mündlich)
• Affinität für Fremdsprachen (Französisch und Englisch)
• mündliche und schriftliche Sprachgewandtheit
• Kontaktfreude, gute Umgangsformen
• Organisationsfähigkeit
• gute Auffassungsgabe
• Verantwortungsbewusstsein
• Zuverlässigkeit
• Flair für Zahlen
• 10-Finger-System Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit den üblichen Unterlagen, Multicheck (falls vorhanden) und Berichten über bereits erfolgte Schnupperlehren. Unsere Kultur - Deine Benefits Das Spital Affoltern als familiärer Ausbildungsbetrieb legt grossen Wert auf eine professionelle Betreuung aller Lernenden in 7 Lehrberufen. Im kaufmännischen Bereich begleiten Dich in jeder Abteilung professionelle Berufsbildnerinnen und Berufsbildner. Im Spital Affoltern erwarten Dich engagierte Teams in einer sehr familiären Umgebung. Diese ist geprägt von hoher Arbeitsqualität und Teamkultur. Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von vielen Vorteilen und regelmässigen Mitarbeiteranlässen (z.B. Tag der Lernenden). "Bi öis kännt mer sich no»: Bei uns ist es familiär und persönlich. Als Teil des Teams des Spitals Affoltern profitierst Du ausserdem von attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen und zahlreichen Fringe Benefits: Jokertag, Einkaufsvorteile und zwei Abos für Gratis-Eintritte in die FORTYSEVEN Wellness-Therme sind nur ein paar Beispiele unserer Mitarbeitervorteile . Über uns Das Spital Affoltern ist der grösste Arbeitgeber und Ausbildungsbetrieb im Knonauer Amt. Rund 550 Mitarbeitende setzen sich bei uns täglich für das Wohl der Patientinnen und Patienten ein. Erfahre mehr über uns in unserem Portrait . Fragen zum Jobinhalt? descriptionByLocale.it:
Applicare per un apprendistato Kaufmann / Kauffrau EFZ Spital Affoltern AG - Affoltern am Albis Lehrstelle Durata 3 anni Agosto 2027 La vostra area di responsabilità Come donna d'affari / uomo EFZ in formazione, si ruota in ospedale Affoltern in modalità mezzo anno attraverso tutti i dipartimenti rilevanti per la vostra professione futura: Alla reception accogliate personalmente i nostri clienti e registrate i dati rilevanti del paziente. Nell'approvvigionamento, si ottiene la conoscenza di una gestione del magazzino professionale e prendersi cura di ordini interni di tutti i tipi. Il dipartimento HR accoglie molto il vostro sostegno nella preparazione di contratti di lavoro e l'organizzazione di eventi. Nel terzo anno di apprendistato, si passa attraverso tutti i processi in finanza e contabilità e imparare l'artigianato di comunicazione interna ed esterna professionale nel marketing. Inoltre, si visita la Business School KV Zurigo per 2 giorni alla settimana. Il tuo profilo
• Scuola obbligatoria completata (Seconda A)
• Tedesco: buono a molto buono (scritta e orale)
• Affinità per le lingue straniere (francese e inglese)
• Fluenza orale e scritta
• Contatto, buone maniere
• Capacità organizzativa
• Buona comprensione
• Responsabilità
• Affidabilità
• Sistema 10-finger Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione con i soliti documenti, multicheck (se disponibile) e rapporti sugli insegnamenti di prova già fatti. L'Ospedale Affoltern come società di formazione familiare attribuisce grande importanza al supporto professionale di tutti gli studenti in 7 apprendisti. Nel settore commerciale, i formatori professionali vi accompagnano in ogni reparto. All'ospedale Affoltern, squadre impegnate vi aspettano in un ambiente molto familiare. Questo è caratterizzato da alta qualità del lavoro e la cultura del team. I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di molti vantaggi e regolari eventi dei dipendenti (ad esempio, Giorno dello Studente). "Bi öis mi conosce no": con noi è famiglia e personale. Benefici come parte della squadra ospedaliera Affoltern Hai anche interessanti condizioni di lavoro e numerosi vantaggi frangia: Jokertag, vantaggi per lo shopping e due abbonamenti per l'ammissione gratuita al centro benessere FORTYSEVEN sono solo alcuni esempi dei nostri vantaggi per i dipendenti. L'Ospedale Affoltern è il più grande datore di lavoro e società di formazione nell'Ufficio Knonau. Circa 550 dipendenti lavorano per il benessere dei pazienti ogni giorno. Scopri di più su di noi nel nostro ritratto. Domande sul contenuto del lavoro? descriptionByLocale.en:
Apply for an apprenticeship Kaufmann / Kauffrau EFZ Spital Affoltern AG - Affoltern am Albis Lehrstelle Duration 3 years August 2027 Your area of responsibility As a businesswoman/man EFZ in training, you rotate in the hospital Affoltern in half-year mode through all departments relevant for your future profession: At the reception you personally welcome our customers and record relevant patient data. In procurement, you gain insight into a professional warehouse management and take care of internal orders of all kinds. The HR department very much welcomes your support in the preparation of employment contracts and the organization of events. In the third year of apprenticeship, you will go through all processes in finance and accounting and learn the craft of professional internal and external communication in marketing. In addition, you visit the Business School KV Zurich for 2 days a week. Your profile
• Compulsory schooling completed (Second A)
• German: good to very good (written and oral)
• Affinity for foreign languages (French and English)
• Oral and written fluency
• Contact, good manners
• Organizational ability
• Good comprehension
• Responsibility
• Reliability
• 10-finger system We look forward to your application with the usual documents, multicheck (if available) and reports on trial teachings already done. The Hospital Affoltern as a family training company attaches great importance to the professional support of all learners in 7 apprenticeships. In the commercial sector, professional vocational trainers accompany you in every department. At the Hospital Affoltern, committed teams await you in a very familiar environment. This is characterized by high work quality and team culture. Our employees benefit from many advantages and regular employee events (e.g. Student Day). "Bi öis knows me no": With us it is family and personal. Benefit as part of the hospital team Affoltern You also have attractive employment conditions and numerous fringe benefits: Jokertag, shopping benefits and two subscriptions for free admissions to the FORTYSEVEN Wellness Spa are just a few examples of our employee benefits. The Hospital Affoltern is the largest employer and training company in the Knonau Office. Around 550 employees work for the well-being of patients every day. Learn more about us in our portrait. Questions about job content? Spital Affoltern AG Eliane Pürro Head of Personnel Development and Education Telephone +41 44 714 27 31 Email eliane.puerro@spitalaffoltern.ch Contact Human Resources Department Eliane Pürro Head of Personnel Development and Education Spital Affoltern AG Telephone: +41 44 714 27 31 Apply

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Demande d'apprentissage Kaufmann / Kauffrau EFZ Spital Affoltern AG - Affoltern am Albis Lehrstelle Durée 3 ans Août 2027 Votre domaine de responsabilité En tant que femme d'affaires/homme d'affaires EFZ en formation, vous faites une rotation à l'hôpital Affoltern en demi-année à travers tous les départements pertinents pour votre future profession: À la réception, vous accueillez personnellement nos clients et enregistrez les données pertinentes du patient. Dans l'approvisionnement, vous obtenez un aperçu de la gestion d'un entrepôt professionnel et de prendre soin des commandes internes de toutes sortes. Le ministère des RH se réjouit de votre soutien dans la préparation des contrats d'emploi et l'organisation des événements. Dans la troisième année d'apprentissage, vous passerez par tous les processus en finance et comptabilité et apprendrez l'artisanat de la communication interne et externe professionnelle dans le marketing. En outre, vous visitez la Business School KV Zurich pour 2 jours par semaine. Votre profil
• Enseignement obligatoire terminé (deuxième A)
• Allemand : bon à très bon (écrit et oral)
• Affinité pour les langues étrangères (français et anglais)
• Maîtrise orale et écrite
• Contact, bonnes manières
• Capacité organisationnelle
• Bonne compréhension
• Responsabilité
• Fiabilité
• Système à 10 doigts Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature avec les documents habituels, multivérification (si disponible) et rapports sur les enseignements d'essai déjà faits. L'hôpital Affoltern, en tant qu'entreprise de formation familiale, attache une grande importance au soutien professionnel de tous les apprenants dans 7 apprentissages. Dans le secteur commercial, des formateurs professionnels vous accompagnent dans chaque département. À l'Hôpital Affoltern, des équipes engagées vous attendent dans un environnement très familier. Cela se caractérise par la qualité du travail et la culture d'équipe. Nos employés bénéficient de nombreux avantages et d'événements réguliers pour les employés (p. ex. Journée étudiante). "Bi öis me connaît non" : avec nous c'est la famille et le personnel. Prestation dans le cadre de l'équipe hospitalière Affoltern Vous disposez également de conditions d'emploi attrayantes et de nombreux avantages sociaux : Jokertag, les avantages du shopping et deux abonnements gratuits au FORTYSEVEN Wellness Spa ne sont que quelques exemples de nos avantages sociaux. L'hôpital Affoltern est le plus grand employeur et entreprise de formation du bureau de Knonau. Environ 550 employés travaillent chaque jour pour le bien-être des patients. En savoir plus sur nous dans notre portrait. Des questions sur le contenu du travail ? Zur Stellenübersicht Bewerben Lehrstelle Lehrstelle Logistiker/-in EFZ Fachrichtung Lager Spital Affoltern AG - Affoltern am Albis Lehrstelle Dauer 3 Jahre August 2027 Dein Aufgabengebiet Als künftige Logistikerin EFZ bzw. künftiger Logistiker EFZ arbeitest du in unserem kleinen Team in der Abteilung Beschaffung mit. Du nimmst Waren aller Art entgegen, kontrollierst sie und bereitest sie für die Aufbewahrung im Zentrallager oder die Auslieferung an die interne und externe Kundschaft vor. Du arbeitest mit medizinischen Produkten, Büromaterial und vielen weiteren Produkten des vielfältigen Bedarfs eines Spitals. In der Fachrichtung Lager bewirtschaftest du unsere Produkte in unserem Lagersystem, unter Einhaltung der Vorschriften, z.B. für die Beladung von Regalen. Du prüfst die Lagerbestände regelmässig un d hilfst mit, einen optimalen Fluss von Warenein- und Warenausgängen sicherzustellen. Es gehört weiter zu deinen abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben, Verpackungen und Abfälle gemäss den Umweltvorschriften zu entsorgen. Während deiner Ausbildung im Spital Affoltern erhältst Du die Gelegenheit, zwei Mal während je zwei Monaten die Lernziele in einem bekannten Partnerbetrieb im Knonauer Amt zu erweitern. Dein Profil
• Abschluss: Sek. A oder Sek. B (mit guten Noten)
• praktisches Verständnis
• handwerkliches Geschick
• Organisationstalent
• gute Deutschkenntnisse
• Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
• Selbstständigkeit
• Ausdauer und Konzentrationsfähigkeit
• Kontaktfreude
• Dienstleistungsbewusstsein Unsere Kultur - Deine Benefits Das Spital Affoltern als familiärer Ausbildungsbetrieb legt grossen Wert auf eine professionelle Betreuung aller Lernenden in 7 Lehrberufen. In der Logistik begleitet dich ein professioneller Berufsbildner, während du vom ersten Tag an in unseren Berufsalltag integriert wirst. Im Spital Affoltern erwarten dich engagierte Teams in einer sehr familiären Umgebung. Diese ist geprägt von hoher Arbeitsqualität und Teamkultur. Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von vielen Vorteilen und regelmässigen Mitarbeiteranlässen (z.B. Tag der Lernenden). «Bi öis kännt mer sich no»: Bei uns ist es familiär und persönlich. Als Teil des Teams des Spitals Affoltern profitierst Du ausserdem von attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen und zahlreichen Fringe Benefits: Jokertag, Einkaufsvorteile und zwei Abos für Gratis-Eintritte in die FORTYSEVEN Wellness-Therme sind nur ein paar Beispiele unserer Mitarbeitervorteile . Über uns Das Spital Affoltern ist der grösste Arbeitgeber und Ausbildungsbetrieb im Knonauer Amt. Rund 550 Mitarbeitende setzen sich bei uns täglich für das Wohl der Patientinnen und Patienten ein. Erfahre mehr über uns in unserem Portrait . Fragen zum Jobinhalt? # Praktikum Studierende Pflege HF ## Mansioni - Assistenza alle persone in diverse fasi della vita - Lavoro in collaborazione con i sistemi familiari e i team interdisciplinari - Responsabilità principale per il processo di assistenza dalla fase di ingresso a quella di uscita - Supporto ai pazienti nel raggiungere i loro obiettivi con le proprie conoscenze e competenze - Aiuto in situazioni acute e in rapido cambiamento - Partecipazione alla formazione degli apprendisti in salute professionale EFZ ## Aree di pratica - Studio in ambito somatico o psichiatrico - Impiego nei seguenti settori: medicina, chirurgia (practicum esterno presso l'ospedale cittadino Triemli di Zurigo), cure palliative, geriatria acuta, psichiatria, gerontopsichiatria, reparto maternità e pediatrico, pronto soccorso, endoscopia/oncologia ##
• Requisiti - Robustezza fisica e psicologica - Comunicazione e lavoro di squadra - Responsabilità - Decisione e riflessione - Buona capacità di osservazione e percezione - Formazione professionale di base di 3 anni con attestato federale di capacità (AFC) o diploma di scuola secondaria (scuola professionale, maturità professionale o maturità liceale) - Superamento della selezione di idoneità/valutazione di ammissione ##

To the job overview Apply Apprenticeship Health Specialist EFZ Acute Care / Psychiatry Spital Affoltern AG - Affoltern am Albis Apprenticeship Duration 3 years August 2027 Your area of ​​responsibility As a health specialist EFZ, you are part of a care team in acute care or in a psychiatric department. You care for and look after patients in everyday hospital life and accompany them on their path to recovery. For example, you support them with personal hygiene (shower, bath, toilet), help with getting dressed, shaving or doing their hair. It is important that you can build a trusting relationship with the people you care for. As an EFZ health specialist in training, you are also responsible for administrative and logistical tasks. Your profile Compulsory schooling completed Very good knowledge of German Sociability, good manners Patience and respect Empathy and willingness to help Good observation skills, quick reactions Careful and precise way of working Sense of cleanliness and order Good physical condition, mental resilience Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours Focus on psychiatry: Minimum age 17 years We look forward to receiving your application with the usual documents, multi-check and reports on trial apprenticeships that have already taken place. Our culture - your benefits As a training company, Spital Affoltern attaches great importance to professional support for all learners in 7 apprenticeships. In the area of ​​nursing, you will be accompanied by two full-time vocational trainers in the department, in addition to practical trainers. In our modern learning workshop you will practice various
• tasks with them regularly and practically. At Affoltern Hospital, committed teams await you in a very familiar environment. This is characterized by high quality care and team culture. Our employees benefit from many benefits and regular employee events (e.g. Learners' Day). “We can’t do anything anymore”: For us it’s family and personal. As part of the Affoltern Hospital team, you also benefit from attractive employment conditions and numerous Fringe benefits: joker day, shopping benefits and two subscriptions for free entry to the FORTYSEVEN wellness spa are just a few examples of our employee benefits. About us The Affoltern Hospital is the largest employer and training company in the Knonauer Amt. Around 550 employees work for the well-being of our patients every day. Find out more about us in our portrait. Questions about job content? Apply Psychotherapist 80-100% Spital Affoltern AG - Affoltern at Albis employees by agreement Psychotherapy is part of the Center for Psychiatry and Psychotherapy with the departments inpatient adult psychiatry, old-age psychiatry, mother-child ward, the integrated day clinic and the psychiatric-psychotherapeutic outpatient. In addition to these tasks, psychotherapy employees also work in the acute hospital in the departments of geriatrics, medicine and palliative care. To strengthen our team in our psychiatric-psychotherapeutic outpatient we are looking for a committed psychotherapist. Their tasks
• Treatment and counselling of patients and their relatives at the Center for Psychiatry and Psychotherapy in the Outpatient Setting
• Independent planning, implementation and documentation of therapies
• Report preparation according to the requirements of the clients (ordering doctors, health insurance, daily allowance insurance, accident insurance, IV and others)
• Interdisciplinary and interprofessional exchange and cooperation
• Cooperation with allocators and institutions
• Participation in supervision, intervisions, case meetings and team meetings
• Moderation of internal training
• With appropriate qualification and interest also management of supervision possible
• Establishment and management of outpatient group therapies with interest and competence possible your profile
• You are a benevolent, responsible and resilient personality with a good dose of humor
• You enjoy working with patients of all age groups of adulthood
• They appreciate the independent work in the outpatient setting but also the connection to a team and bring openness to different therapeutic directions.
• You have a great interest in interdisciplinary and interprofessional cooperation
• You have completed further training as a Swiss-approved psychotherapist or are about to graduate
• Several years of professional experience are advantageous, if possible also in the ambulatory setting We offer
• Very varied, interesting activity in our ambulatorium
• Working in a very well-coordinated, supportive, open and creative team
• Space for self-responsible, self-initiative work with options for co-creation
• Training opportunities in the form of supervision, intervision and hospital-internal and external training
• Family institution with appreciative work culture and flat hierarchies
• Attractive employment conditions with good insurance services Our culture – Your benefits «Bi öis can mer no»: With us it is family and personal. descriptionByLocale.it: Applicazione per i tirocinanti / tirocinante Psichiatria (Focus Age and Adult Psychiatry) ## Durata e condizioni di lavoro - Stage da 6 a 12 mesi (uso 80-100%) - Spital Affoltern AG – Affoltern am Albis - Dipendenti per accordo --- ##STR1## Vuoi ottenere la prima esperienza nello spazio di lavoro psichiatrico e ottenere una visione versatile nella cura? Nel Centro per la Psichiatria e la Psicoterapia dell'ospedale di Affoltern, vi sarà data l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente alla clinica di tutti i giorni e per scoprire se la professione di cura si adatta. La psichiatria adulta comprende 24 letti e tratta le persone di età compresa tra 18 e 65 anni. La psichiatria di età con 16 letti supervisiona le persone a partire dai 65 anni. I nostri pazienti sono in una crisi mentale acuta. Il focus è sulla diagnosi, la terapia e la stabilizzazione delle malattie mentali. Essi accompagnano i pazienti di psichiatria adulta e di età attraverso le cliniche quotidiane e li sostengono nella struttura quotidiana. Aiutano il team di assistenza in semplici attività di allattamento e organizzative. Essi sostengono il dipartimento in compiti logistici e assicurano che i materiali e le aree di lavoro siano organizzati. Si otterrà interessanti intuizioni nella diagnosi e terapia di malattie mentali. --- Compiti - Supporto nella strutturazione quotidiana dei pazienti - Accompagnamento nella clinica quotidiana di psichiatria adulta e di età - Supporto per attività di assistenza - Aiuto con il supporto organizzativo e logistico del dipartimento - Organizzazione di materiali e aree di lavoro --- # - Curiosità: interesse nella cura e nel trattare con le persone in situazioni difficili - Personalità: sensibilità, affidabilità e spirito di squadra - Mindset: apertura per nuovi e senza timori di contatto con malattie mentali - conoscenza precedente: Non necessariamente richiesto - Più importante della conoscenza precedente: disponibilità per l'apprendimento e la consapevolezza della responsabilità --- # Cosa # - Atmosfera culturale: è famiglia e personale (“Bi öis kännt mer sich no”) - Condizioni interessanti e numerose frange Vantaggi, tra cui: - Jokertag (giorno di lavoro flessibile) - Vantaggi per lo shopping - Due abbonamenti per l'ammissione gratuita alla FORTYSEVEN Wellness-Therme --- # Contatto # Domande sul contenuto del lavoro? - Melanie Brügger, Co-Head Care, Social and Therapies - Telefono: +41 44 714 33 94 - Email: melanie.bruegger@spitalaffoltern.ch Applicazione: - Marina Radošević, personale specializzato - Telefono: +41 44 714 26 94
descriptionByLocale.en:
Application for interns / intern Psychiatry (Focus Age and Adult Psychiatry) ## Duration and working conditions - Internship from 6 to 12 months (80–100% use) - Spital Affoltern AG – Affoltern am Albis - Employees by agreement --- ##STR1## Would you like to gain first experience in the psychiatric workspace and get a versatile insight into the care? In the Centre for Psychiatry and Psychotherapy of the Affoltern hospital, you will be given the opportunity to actively participate in the everyday clinic and to find out if the nursing profession fits you. The adult psychiatry comprises 24 beds and treats people aged 18 to 65 years. The age psychiatry with 16 beds supervises people from the age of 65. Our patients are in an acute mental crisis. The focus is on the diagnosis, therapy and stabilization of mental diseases. They accompany patients of adult and age psychiatrics through everyday clinics and support them in the daily structure. They help the care team in simple nursing and organizational activities. They support the department in logistical tasks and ensure that materials and work areas are organised. You will get exciting insights into the diagnosis and therapy of mental illnesses. --- Tasks - Support in day structuring of patients - Accompaniment in the everyday clinic of adult and age psychiatrics - Support for easy care activities - Help with the organizational and logistical support of the department - Organization of materials and work areas --- ## - Curiosity: Interest in care and dealing with people in difficult situations - Personality: sensitivity, reliability and team spirit - Mindset: Openness for new and no fears of contact with mental illness - previous knowledge: Not necessarily required - More important than previous knowledge: readiness for learning and awareness of responsibility --- ##
• Cosa offriamo - Cultural atmosphere: it is family and personal (“Bi öis kännt mer sich no”) - Attractive conditions and numerous fringes Benefits, including: - Jokertag (flexible working day) - Shopping benefits - Two subscriptions for free admissions to the FORTYSEVEN Wellness-Therme --- # Contatto Questions about the job content? - Melanie Brügger, Co-Head Care, Social and Therapies - Telephone: +41 44 714 33 94 - Email: melanie.bruegger@spitalaffoltern.ch Application: - Marina Radošević, specialist staff - Telephone: +41 44 714 26 94
